def solve():
    target = 290
    held = 60
    vintage = 2024
    eligible = vintage >= 2020
    price = Q("9.25")
    resale = price * Q("0.9")
    if eligible:
        applied = min(held, target)
        surplus_held = held - applied
        legacy = Q(0)
    else:
        applied = 0
        surplus_held = 0
        legacy = held * Q("4.5")
    shortfall = max(target - applied, 0)
    bundles = -(-shortfall // 100)
    bought = bundles * 100
    excess = bought - shortfall
    cost = bought * price
    surplus = excess + surplus_held
    proceeds = surplus * resale + legacy
    net = cost - proceeds
    return {
        "final": net,
        "applied_held_credits": applied,
        "bundles_purchased": bundles,
        "surplus_credits": surplus,
    }
